source.title: Experimental Null Test of a Mach Effect Thruster
source.why_relevant: CSUF authors (Fearn & Woodward) report both a positive thrust and a designed null test in which the thrust disappears.
source.quote: Abstract: "Then we show how this thrust can be eliminated by having two heavy masses at either end of the stack with a central mounting bracket... We find the thrust does indeed disappear in the experiment, as predicted." Full text (Sec. 2.2): "Here we show a clear thrust of approximately 1.5 µN."
source.geometry_or_result: Measured thrust approximately 1.5 µN in thruster mode (no uncertainty stated); null result: net thrust disappears with equal masses at both ends, as predicted (vibration/systematic check).

source.title: Experimental Investigation of Mach-Effect Thrusters on Torsion Balances
source.why_relevant: TU Dresden (Monette, Kössling, Tajmar) replication campaign reporting artifact-level forces and a conventional explanation for Woodward's signals.
source.quote: Abstract: "It is concluded that the observed effect is a result of coupled vibrations on the torsion balance." Sec. 6: "the forces are much lower than predicted (3 to 30 nN/W), and are present in thruster orientations that should not result in thrust... the effects observed by Woodward using the MEGA drive on a torsion balance can be explained by thermal and vibrational artefacts using Newtonian mechanics."
source.geometry_or_result: No confirmed uniaxial thrust; observed forces 3–30 nN/W, orders below claimed µN-level forces, appearing in orientations that should yield zero thrust; attributed to thermal and vibrational artefacts.

source.title: The SpaceDrive Project - Thrust Balance Development and New Measurements of the Mach-Effect and EMDrive Thrusters
source.why_relevant: TU Dresden (Kössling et al., IAC-18, Bremen 2018) test campaign reporting no real Mach-effect thrust and attributing signals to thermal drifts.
source.quote: Results discussion: tests "were performed and indicate thermal drifts instead of real thrusts. This needs to be further investigated."
source.geometry_or_result: No real thrust observed; measured signals attributed to non-linear thermal drifts rather than thrust.
